findings.reason: All 73 stored models are version 2; an authenticated incremental re-import is required to persist real Notion views.
Paginated list/detail calls, normalized view types, order, filters, sorts, groups and configuration are implemented and covered by tests.
Month navigation, date ranges, no-date items, stable ordering and source-page links are implemented.
Version 3 validation and rendering preserve supported Notion property types without the former 12-column truncation.
Names require Notion user visibility; missing permission is shown explicitly and is not changed automatically.
